title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: 2-D conservative perfect-gas equations and reference coefficients source/report-supported.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Separate TRI_3/QUAD_4 multizone sections with geometric matching; MIXED unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative face residual and global norms implemented; no independent order study.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: HLLC subsonic and Rusanov supersonic defaults implemented; no independent shock verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths and wall boundary semantics documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ Barth-type limiter and fallback; steady shock-free limiter freeze disclosed, no independent smooth-order test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Selective steady limiter freezing is disclosed; exact historical source/binary/environment unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:600–609 integrates tangential shear force; wall gradients/heat flux implemented.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS present; residual target+1.5 shortcut can terminate while long-window forces still drift as M2 does.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Current source reevaluates full residual and limiter before target comparison; historical Re200 revision predates source changes and binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, root-only global preprocessing, owned/ghost halos and reductions; compared M015 np8 revision differs from np1/2/4.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
